app.name: Ritmo
app.tagline: One quiet message. Your whole day in rhythm.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Ritmo is your quiet daily companion inside Telegram. One morning message. Streaks that keep you honest. Bill reminders only when they matter.
onboarding.welcomePoint1: Morning digest: weather, calendar, prices, one news item
onboarding.welcomePoint2: Habit streaks with a one-tap check-in
onboarding.welcomePoint3: Bills & subscriptions that warn a few days before due
onboarding.welcomePoint4: Private cycle tracking — only if you want it
onboarding.languageBody: You can change this anytime in Profile.
onboarding.cityTitle: Where should we look up weather?
onboarding.cityBody: Used only for your morning digest.
onboarding.hourBody: We'll send one short digest around this hour.
onboarding.habitsBody: Tap a few. You can add more later. Streaks make it stick.
onboarding.billsBody: Rent, internet, phone… Ritmo stays quiet until a few days before due.
onboarding.cycleBody: Private predictions and gentle reminders. Skip if this isn't for you.
onboarding.doneBody: Open Home each day, check in habits, and let Ritmo nudge you only when it matters.

home.subtitle: Your rhythm today
home.whatIsThis: Ritmo keeps digest, habits, and bills in one calm place.

habits.title: Habits
habits.hint: Tap check-in every day. Don't break the chain.
habits.empty: No habits yet. Add one to start a streak.

bills.title: Bills
bills.hint: Quiet most of the month. Loud only when due.
bills.empty: No bills yet. Add rent, phone, or subscriptions.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.hint: Manual events show up in your morning digest.

digest.title: Morning digest
digest.hint: One short message each morning. That's enough to stay useful.

profile.title: Profile
profile.premiumHint: In the bot, send /premium to pay with Telegram Stars.
